timing: Immediately following resolution of turn 23 actions and before turn 0 of the next day

mechanics_summary.source_of_items: private['inventories'] (index 0 is farmer, subsequent indices are hired hands)
mechanics_summary.deposit_logic: For each worker inventory, for each item: take = min(n, capacity - current_shed_total). If take > 0, shed[item] += take. del inv[item] unconditionally deletes the inventory item.
mechanics_summary.discard_mechanism: Any units exceeding remaining capacity (n - take) are deleted from inv without entering shed, producing permanent inventory destruction.
mechanics_summary.worker_precedence: Worker index 0 (farmer) processes first, followed by hired hands in list order (1, 2, ...).
mechanics_summary.item_precedence: Iterates over inv.items() in dict insertion order.
mechanics_summary.seeds_treatment: Seeds reside in private['seeds'] and are excluded from shed and from midnight drop/discard mechanics.
